# MusicallyDown

> MusicallyDown is a free, browser-based tool for saving public TikTok videos as MP4 and extracting the audio as MP3, when those formats are available.

## About
MusicallyDown needs no app and no account. A visitor copies a TikTok video link, pastes it into the box on the homepage and chooses from the download options shown. Available formats depend on the original video. The site encourages downloading only content you created or have permission to keep.

## Languages
English (https://musicaldown.se/), Spanish (https://musicaldown.se/es/), Indonesian (https://musicaldown.se/id/) and Vietnamese (https://musicaldown.se/vi/).
